name: tattlr
description: Checks every tool call against your local tattlr policy before it runs.

bin.description: Path to the tattlr binary. Defaults to $TATTLR_BIN, then tattlr on PATH.

failClosed.description: Block the tool call if tattlr can't be reached. Off by default.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for tattlr. Default 10000.
